name: tide-gradient
title: Tide gradient
description: Pools of cyan, mint and steel blue swell and sink into black. It loops with no join.

props.name: colors
props.doc: The six pool colours: by default cyan, mint, sea green, blue, steel and deep teal.

props.name: ground
props.doc: What shows where no pool reaches (black).

props.name: scale
props.doc: Size of the pools: higher is larger.

props.name: depth
props.doc: How much black opens between the pools.

props.name: speed
props.doc: Loops per 10 seconds. Whole numbers loop seamlessly.
